description: This file is a C source file for configuring an RTOS module ('Os'). It includes definitions for application initialization, counters, alarms, tasks, hooks, and ISR mapping for an MPC5567 microcontroller. The file specifies various OS parameters, task stacks, alarms auto-start settings, and application descriptors.

methods.name: GEN_APPLICATION
methods.description: Defines an application with specified parameters such as ID, name, and core assignment.

methods.name: GEN_COUNTER
methods.description: Defines a hardware counter used for timing and alarms.

methods.name: GEN_ALARM
methods.description: Configures an alarm with timing and action behavior.

methods.name: DECLARE_STACK
methods.description: Declares a stack for a task.

methods.name: GEN_TASK
methods.description: Defines a task with priority, scheduling, and starting parameters.

methods.name: GEN_HOOKS
methods.description: Sets up hook callbacks for startup, shutdown, error, and task hooks.
